Summary: Fear is a natural human response to danger and uncertainty, but Scripture repeatedly calls God's people not to be ruled by it because God is with them. The fear of the Lord, reverent awe, actually drives out lesser fears. Again and again, 'do not fear' comes with a promise: I am with you, I will help you, I will never leave you.
KeyPassages: Genesis 15:1; Isaiah 41:10; Psalm 56:3; Matthew 10:28-31; 2 Timothy 1:7; 1 John 4:18
RelatedDoctrines: Fear; Fear of the Lord; Trust in God
RelatedQuestions: What does the Bible say about fear?; How can I stop being afraid when I cannot control the future?
RelatedBooks: Genesis; Psalms; Isaiah; Matthew; 2 Timothy; 1 John
